name: Agent Skills (Anthropic)
what: Anthropic's public repository of Agent Skills: folders with a SKILL.md file (plus optional scripts and resources) that Claude loads when a task needs them. It includes example skills, the document skills behind Claude's file creation, a skill template and a copy of the Agent Skills spec (the open standard lives at agentskills.io). Many skills are Apache-2.0; the document skills are source-available, not open source.
who: Claude Code and Claude.ai users who want ready-made skills, or a starting point to write their own. Anthropic says the example skills are already available on paid Claude.ai plans.

setup.text: In Claude Code, add the repo as a plugin marketplace:
To write your own, make a folder with a SKILL.md that has a name and description in its YAML frontmatter:
setup.code:
---
name: my-skill-name
description: What this skill does and when to use it
---
# My Skill Name
Instructions Claude should follow...

setup.text: The repo says these skills are for demonstration and education; behavior in Claude may differ.

prompts: Use the PDF skill to extract the form fields from forms/application.pdf.
Create a skill that writes release notes in our team's format.
Use the skill-creator skill to help me turn my code review checklist into a skill.
